structure: Part 1 of 1 read the whole of workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-sam-2026-11-04.md, all 22 lines, and claims every point in it; nothing is left to another part. The file follows the ruling layout of references/DISTIL.md section 6: an H1 ("Ruling: Sam, 4 November 2026"), then two context sentences each followed by one verbatim block quote of Sam's own words, then a numbered list of 4 claims the main session read from those quotes. Context sentence 1 (lines 3-4) frames quote 1 (line 6) as splitting the "What are you importing?" type question off the type question and templates theme (EUDPA-690) after templates was de-prioritised; quote 1 is "split off the what are you improting page from the templates stuff. handle it nicely in a new theme I think." Context sentence 2 (lines 8-9) frames quote 2 (lines 11-12) as being about the two type question rows held as deferred since the 12 October pause, which it names as the origin page's Back link and Back from a review Change link; quote 2 is "if in doubt include them. all the rows go on one branch and dont merge it if you happen to finish. dont let the stuff forget links etc need to work in CDP as well as local docker stack and CI docker stack". The 4 numbered claims (lines 14-22) are: templates de-prioritised with its rows parked in themes/type-question-and-templates and not built now; the type question rows building in themes/type-question on one branch feat/EUDPA-690-type-question in every repo they touch, with the two deferred rows included as to do; the branch not merged when its last row lands, Sam merging it; and every link, redirect and form hand-over between services working in CDP, the local Docker stack and the CI Docker stack the pull request end-to-end runs use, each taking its address from the service's own configuration as the existing links do and never from a hard-coded host or port. Coverage of this part: both context sentences, both quotes and all 4 numbered claims are claimed, each decision of quote 2 taken separately (include the doubtful rows, one branch, do not merge on finishing, links working in three environments), with the theme names, the branch name, the two rows' identity, the "redirect"/"form hand-over"/"own configuration"/"never hard-coded"/"the pull request end-to-end runs" details marked inferred because they come from the context sentences and the main session's numbered claims rather than from Sam's quoted words. Every numbered claim in the file is marked "New.", so no claim here answers a question or conflict from an earlier report and no such note is written. The file carries no tables, images or links to other documents, and says nothing about page content, wording, layout, components or question order beyond the "What are you importing?" page moving into a theme of its own. Six points the ruling touches but leaves open are recorded as gap claims: what "handle it nicely" requires of the new theme, what becomes of the parked templates rows, which repos the branch spans, when or on what condition Sam merges the branch, what happens to work that depends on the unmerged branch, and how "links etc" working in three environments is to be proved.
